notes.title: Season 2 RELEASE DATE & NEW TRAILER
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that Projekt: Passion - Season 2 is coming to Steam on April 4th!

Wishlist now to be notified as soon as it drops, and while you're there, do check out the new story trailer! 

↓ Or click this cool gif to watch it! ↓

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/059ac500774308aae554c02af3442dfd3f61fb0f.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863160/Projekt_Passion__Season_2/

For those who have been holding off, Season 1 is currently at it's biggest sale yet, get it while you can because it will soon go back to its normal sale price.

That's all, stay classy!

notes.title: Release information and more teasers
notes.notes:
I just started working on the final chapter of Season 2, and if it takes roughly as long as previous chapters it should be ready in February or March, meaning that we're probably looking at a March release here on Steam. This is just preliminary however so take it with a grain of salt, I'll post another announcement when I have a more concrete release date.

The price will be the same as Season 1, however you'll be getting a lot more content at a significantly higher quality, early impressions have been very favorable so I'm positive that you'll be pleased with what's provided.

Quality takes time, and I want it to be as high quality as possible. Have some additional teasers as thanks for your patience! Do consider wishlisting

notes.title: 0.7.1 - Turkish translation and some smaller changes
notes.notes:
Hello all! A few updates to the game has been added

- Turkish translation is now available in the Options menu.

- Some improvements to the Italian translation have been made.

- There is now a Sync Steam Achievements button in the Options menu, this will sync your achievements with Steam in case you previously unlocked them in a non-Steam version of the game.

Upcoming translations are French and Spanish (Latin America).

That's it for now, cheers and take care!
